text.en: 1. This Order is the Infrastructure Protection (Protected Places) (No. 25) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 3 January 2025.

heading.en: Premises declared to be protected place

text.en: 2. The premises described in the second column of the Schedule are declared to be a protected place for the purposes of the Act, and the person specified in the first column of that Schedule is designated as the authority of the protected place.
